title: 第十一章 绕道而行第十二章 君山烈
content_zh:

read2（）;演武场所有人的目光全部聚焦在演武台上一龙一虎虚影所交织的地方！
因为他们知道，胜负即将揭晓！
林璎珞冰冷的目光注视着演武台，突然耳边响起一道淡淡的自语声让她神情一动。
“越阶而战……胜负已分。”
这句话正是出自负手而立的龙光城主齐世龙，林璎珞可以感觉到齐世龙此话当中所饱含的一丝赞赏之意。
此时的慕容白石早已没有了先前的笃定，干枯老脸上的肌肉微微扯动，眼中寒意若隐若现，死死盯着演武台上纵横激荡的龙虎虚影，虽然慕容白石无法确认到底谁会赢，但他心中却隐隐有着一丝不妙的感觉。
慕容长青虽然察觉到慕容白石的异样，可他心中同样惊意莫名，如果说先前林无缺展现出锻体大圆满的实力让慕容长青大怀安慰的话。那么后来林无缺修为再度暴涨，力拼实力全开的慕容天而不落下风，就使得他心中涌上了一抹震惊。
慕容长青突然发现，自己对于这个自幼在眼皮下长大的少年原来并不是那么的了解。
“到底谁会赢？”
“一定是慕容天！他可是洗凡境的实力啊！”
“可林无缺好像不弱于他！”
……
慕容子弟的议论似乎从未停歇过，同为年少之人，自然血气方刚，演武台上大战的二人，牵动着所有慕容子弟的神经，他们很想知道，究竟谁会赢，究竟……谁才是慕容家年轻一代第一人！
慕容冰兰的呼吸早已急促不已，一双美眸当中满是惊骇和不可思议，但更多的却是无法置信，她根本无法想通她口中的那个废物为什么能和她的天哥大战到如此境地。
芊芊玉手紧握，慕容冰兰“哗”的一声从原地站起身来，俏脸紧绷，死死地盯着演武台。
就在众人心绪各异之时，一道震天的长啸突然从演武台上响起，紧接着这道长啸之后却是一句高亢霸烈的话语！
“给我败吧！”
“嘭”“咚”
一股淡金色的元力蓦地冲天而起，整个演武台仿佛一震，虎吼不绝，顿时一道身影被一股巨力沛然轰出，狼狈至极！

“噗”
一口嫣红的鲜血吐出，这道狼狈的身影使出全力想稳住身子，却终究失败了。
嘭的一声摔倒在已经被力量肆掠破碎的演武台石板之上，嫣红的鲜血再度接连吐出两口。
“嗡”
淡金色元力震颤，最终缓缓散去，一道修长的身影从中浮现，落在了演武场所有人的目光当中。
脸庞俊秀，目光璀璨，黑发飘扬，正是林无缺！
而躺在距离林无缺十丈之外的石板上口吐鲜血、目光布满惊骇，怨毒，犹如择人而噬的毒蛇般的正是身影慕容天！
这一战，胜负已分！
林无缺，凭借自己的力量终于战胜了慕容天。
“天！是林无缺！林无缺打赢了慕容天！”
“真是太厉害了！”
“我不敢相信自己的眼睛啊！”

read2(); The eyes of everyone in the martial arts arena are all focused on the place where the shadows of a dragon and a tiger are intertwined on the martial arts stage!
Because they know that the winner is about to be announced!
Lin Yingluo stared at the martial arts stage with cold eyes, and suddenly a faint muttering sounded in her ears, which made her expression change.
"Fight across the levels...the outcome is decided."
These words came from Qi Shilong, the master of Longguang City who stood on his own initiative. Lin Yingluo could feel the hint of appreciation contained in Qi Shilong's words.
At this time, Murong Baishi no longer had the previous determination. The muscles on his withered old face were twitching slightly, and there was a looming coldness in his eyes. He was staring at the phantoms of dragons and tigers on the martial arts stage. Although Murong Baishi could not confirm who would win, he had a vague feeling in his heart.
Although Murong Changqing noticed something strange about Murong Baishi, he was also surprised and inexplicable. If Lin Wuque showed the perfect strength of body training before, Murong Changqing was very comforted. Then Lin Wuque's cultivation level skyrocketed again, and he tried his best to compete with Murong Tian who was at full strength without falling behind, which made him feel shocked.
Murong Changqing suddenly realized that he didn't know that much about this young man who had grown up under his eyes since childhood.
"Who will win?"
"It must be Murong Tian! He has the strength of the Mortal Cleansing Realm!"
"But Lin Wuque seems to be no weaker than him!"
…
The discussion among the Murong disciples seems to have never stopped. They are both young and full of energy. The two fighting on the martial arts stage have affected the nerves of all the Murong disciples. They want to know who will win, and who... is the number one among the younger generation of the Murong family!
Murong Binglan's breathing was already rapid, her beautiful eyes were full of horror and disbelief, but more of it was disbelief. She couldn't figure out why the trash in her mouth could fight to such a degree with her Tian brother.
Qianqianyu clenched her hands tightly, and Murong Binglan stood up from the spot with a "wow" sound, her pretty face tightened, and she stared at the martial arts stage.
Just when everyone was in different moods, a loud roar suddenly sounded from the martial arts stage, followed immediately by a high-pitched and domineering word!
"Defeat me!"
"Bang" "Dong"
A burst of light golden Yuan Power suddenly shot up into the sky, and the entire martial arts stage seemed to be shaken. Tigers roared endlessly, and a figure was suddenly blasted out by a huge force. It was extremely embarrassing!
"Poof"
Spitting out a mouthful of bright red blood, the embarrassed figure tried its best to stabilize its body, but failed in the end.
With a bang, he fell onto the stone slab of the martial arts platform that had been ripped apart by force, and spit out two mouthfuls of bright red blood.
"Buzz"
The pale golden energy trembled, and finally slowly dispersed, and a slender figure emerged from it and fell into the eyes of everyone in the martial arts field.
With a handsome face, bright eyes, and flying black hair, it was Lin Wuque!
And lying on the stone slab ten feet away from Lin Wuque, vomiting blood, eyes full of horror and resentment, like a poisonous snake that chooses people to eat, it is the figure Murong Tian!
This battle has been won or lost!
Lin Wuque finally defeated Murong Tian with his own strength.
"Oh my god! It's Lin Wuque! Lin Wuque defeated Murong Tian!"
"It's really amazing!"
"I can't believe my eyes!"
